topic: Romanov / Anastasia: DNA vs Anna Anderson

scenes.vo: She swore she was the Tsar's lost daughter. Was she telling the truth?
headline: THE TSAR’S
LOST
DAUGHTER?

scenes.vo: In 1918, the Romanov family vanished. Rumors said Anastasia escaped.
In 1920, a woman in Berlin claimed to be her.
In 1991, a hidden grave was found. DNA matched the Tsar's family.
DNA confirmed all five children died. Anna's matched a Polish factory worker.
scenes.title: DNA TEST
